title: Colonel Blanchard announces a crashed flying saucer
place_text: Roswell Army Air Field, New Mexico

tellings.quote: so they said uh everybody was seeing UFOs. So, the uh base commander, who was a very well-liked fellow, very popular fellow named Colonel Blanchard, called up the newspaper and said um you know, "Look what we found. We found a crashed flying saucer."

plain: A scientist named John Brandenburg, on the podcast of host Jesse Michels, retells what he says veterans of the Roswell base told him. According to them, in 1947 everyone was seeing UFOs, and the well-liked commander of Roswell Army Air Field, a military base in New Mexico, Colonel Blanchard, called the local newspaper and announced they had found a crashed flying saucer. If true, it would mean the military itself once openly admitted recovering an alien craft.
